dadhibhiḥ snāpayitvā ca pūjayet bhaktitaḥ budhaḥ

tat toyam rakta tulyam syāt na gṛhṇāti tatas hariḥ

samastam labhate kāmam keśavasya anukaṃpayā

a dhautena ca vastreṇa yaḥ pūjām kurute hareḥ

yaiḥ tu abaddha śikhaiḥ pūjā kriyate cakriṇaḥ janaiḥ

a saṃskṛta gṛhe pūjā kriyate jagatīpateḥ
sā a pūjā brāhmaṇa śreṣṭha bali grāhyā bhavet khalu
snānam deva arcanam ca eva dānam ca pitṛ pūjanam
tilakena vinā vipra kuru tena vicakṣaṇaḥ
tilakāni a gṛhītvā yat puṇya karma vidhīyate
bhasmībhavati tat sarvam kartā ca nārakībhavet
śaṅkha cakra gadā padmaiḥ aṅkitam yasya dṛśyate

pātakam sakalaṃtasya kṣaṇāt eva tu naśyati

murāri pāda yugmam ca sva lalāṭe likhet budhaḥ 61

aṣṭa akṣaram mahā maṃtram matsyam kūrmam ca yaḥ hṛdi
likhet sa vaiṣṇava śreṣṭhaḥ punāti bhuvanatrayam

tasya kṛṣṇaḥ jagannāthaḥ dadāti paramam padam
kṛṣṇa āyudha aṃkita tanuḥ yat karma kurute naraḥ

śokaḥ na jāyate tasya kadācid hṛdaye dvija
kārtike ca samāyāte sarva māsa uttame śubhe
dāmodaram devadevam bhaktyā prājñaḥ prapūjayet
yathā ukta vidhinā prājñaḥ prātaḥsnānam samācaret
āmiṣam maithunam ca eva kārtike māsi yaḥ tyajet
janma antara arjitaiḥ pāpaiḥ muktaḥ yāti parām gatim
tulā rāśi gate sūrye prātaḥsnānam dvijottama 75
haviṣyam brahmacaryam ca mahāpātaka nāśanam
āmiṣam maithunam ca eva kārtike māsi sevate
janma janmani vipra indra sa bhavet grāma śūkaraḥ

āyāte kārtike māsi yatnāt api parityajet
dāmodarāya nabhasi dīpam yaḥ tu prayacchati
phalam tasya pravakṣyāmi samāsena śṛṇu dvija
brahmahatyā ādibhiḥ pāpaiḥ vimuktaḥ kleśa dāyakaiḥ
dāmodara puram gatvā tiṣṭhet koṭi yuga avadhi
dīpam jvalaṃtam nabhasi tridaśāḥ vāsava ādayaḥ

asau puṇya ātmanām śreṣṭhaḥ keśava arcana tatparaḥ

dine dine śvamedhasya phalam prāpnoti mānavaḥ
tulasī dala lakṣaiḥ yaḥ kārtike pūjayet harim
lakṣa eka vājimedhasya mānavaḥ labhate phalam

ye dīna loka hṛdaya ati sukha pradāḥ ca teṣām aham satatam eva bhaṭāḥ adhīnaḥ
ye satya vākya kathaneṣu sadā anurakta āloka priyāḥ ca śaraṇa āgata lokapālāḥ
paśyaṃti ye ca satatam viṣavat para svaṃte māna vāma madhu ṭān ahi daṃḍanīyāḥ
ye ca anna dāna niratāḥ salila pradāḥ ca bhūmi prada nikhila loka hita eṣiṇaḥ ca
ye vṛtti hīna jana tṛpti karāḥ praśāṃtāḥ dūtāḥ nate khalu kadāpi ca daṃḍanīyāḥ
ye jñāti poṣaṇa ratāḥ priya vādinaḥ ca yedambha kopa mada matsara hīna cittāḥ
ye pāpa dṛṣṭi rahita avijita iṃdri yāḥ ca teṣām aham na vidadhāmi kadāpi carcām
vyāsaḥ uvāca
evam prabodhitāḥ tena yamena yama kiṃkarāḥ
jñātavaṃtaḥ jagadbhartuḥ prabhāvam atulam hareḥ
viṣṇoḥ nāmāni vipra indra sarva deva adhikāni vai
teṣām madhye tu tattva jñāḥ rāma nāma varam smṛtam
rāma iti akṣara yugmam hi sarvam maṃtra adhikam dvija
yad uccāraṇa mātreṇa pāpīyāḥ ati parām gatim
rāma nāma prabhāvam hi sarva deva prapūjanam
maheśaḥ eva jānāti na anyaḥ jānāti jaimine
viṣṇoḥ nāma sahasrāṇām paṭhanāt labhate phalam
tat phalam labhate martyaḥ rāma nāma smaran api
aho citram manuṣyāṇām caritram idam ucyate
rāmaiḥ iti mukti dam nāmana smaraṃti durāśayāḥ 91
vaktum śramaḥ na ca alpaḥ pi śrotum atyaṃta sundaram
tathā api rāma rāma iti na vadaṃti durāśayāḥ 92
atyaṃta duḥkha labhyā api muktiḥ jagati mānavaiḥ
labhyate rāma nāmnā eva karma asti kim atas param
tāvat tiṣṭhaṃti pāpāni deheṣu dehinām vara
rāma rāma iti yāvat vā enaḥ smaraṃti sukha pradam
śrāddhe ca tarpaṇe ca eva bali dāne tathā utsave
yajñe dāne vrate ca eva devatā ārādhane pi ca
anyeṣu api ca kāryeṣu vaidikeṣu vicakṣaṇaḥ
smaret yaḥ tad phala prepsu ūrāmarāma iti bhaktitaḥ 96
namaḥ rāmāya iti vipra indra mantram oṅkāra pūrvakam
ṣaḍakṣaram japet yaḥ tu sāyujyam prāpyate hareḥ
ṣaḍakṣareṇa maṃtreṇa hari pūjana kṛt naraḥ
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti prasādāt cakrapāṇinaḥ
mṛtyu kāle dvijaśreṣṭha rāma rāma iti yaḥ smaret
sa pāpiṣṭhaḥ api paramam mokṣam āpnoti mānavaḥ
rāma iti nāma yātrāyām ye smaraṃti manīṣiṇaḥ
sarva siddhiḥ bhavet teṣām yātrāyām na atra saṃśayaḥ 100
araṇye prāṃtare vāpī śmaśāne ya ubhayānake
rāma nāma smaret tasya vidyam tena āpadā udvija
rājadvāre tathā durge videśe dasyu saṃmukhe
duḥsvapna darśane ca eva grahapīḍāsu jaimine
autpātike bhaye ca eva vāta roga bhaye tathā
rāma nāma asmaran martyaḥ labhate na aśubham kvacid
kāma dam mokṣa dam ca eva smartavyam satatam budhaiḥ
rāma nāmā iti viprarṣe yasmin a smaryata īkṣaṇe
kṣaṇaḥ saḥ eva vyarthaḥ syāt satyam eva mayā ucyate 105
smaraṃtaḥ hari nāmāni nā avasīdaṃti mānavāḥ
janma koṭi durita kṣayam icchuḥ saṃpadam ca labhate bhuvi martyaḥ
viṣṇu nāma satatam bhuvi bhaktyā mokṣa dāti madhuram smarati sma
iti śrī padmapurāṇe kriyāyogasāre paṃcadaśaḥ adhyāyaḥ 15
ṣoḍaśaḥ adhyāyaḥ
vyāsaḥ uvāca
bhūyas eva dvijaśreṣṭha mahāviṣṇoḥ parātmanaḥ
bravīmi śṛṇu māhātmyam sarva duḥkha vināśanam
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣattriya vaiśyāḥ śūdrāḥ ca anyenti ajāḥ tathā
hari bhaktim prapannāḥ yete kṛtārthān asaṃśayaḥ 2
hareḥ abhaktaḥ vipraḥ api vijñeyaḥ śvapaca adhikaḥ
haribhaktaḥ śvapākaḥ api vijñeyaḥ brāhmaṇa adhikaḥ
sa katham brāhmaṇaḥ yaḥ tu hari bhakti vivarjitaḥ
sa katham śvapacaḥ yaḥ tu bhagavat bhakti mānasaḥ
a vyājena yadā viṣṇuḥ śvapākena api pūjyate
tadā apaśyet tam api evam catur veda dvija adhikam
purā āsīt cakrikaḥ nāma śabaraḥ loka karṣa kṛt
su jāti vṛtti hīnaḥ ca yuge dvāpara saṃjñake
dayāluḥ ddambha hīnaḥ ca pitṛ mātṛ parāyaṇaḥ 7
na kṛtaḥ vaiṣṇavaḥ lāpaḥ mokṣa śāstram na ca śrutam
tathā api jātā a tad cittā hari bhaktiḥ acañcalā
hare keśava govinda vāsudeva janārdana
ityādīni smaran nityam saca nāmāni cakriṇaḥ
vanyam phalam ca yat kiñcid prāpnoti dvijasattama
ādau dadāti tad vaktre nija īśabara vaṃśa jaḥ
tat mādhuryam tatas jñātvā vaktrāt niṣkāsya tat punar
dadāti haraye bhaktyā su prītaḥ prativāsaram 11
ucchiṣṭam vā pi anucchiṣṭam dvayam eva na vetti saḥ
nija jāti svabhāvaḥ hi satatam mūrgh nivartate
kadācid sa dvija śreṣṭha kānana abhyaṃtare bhraman
phalam ekam prāpya pakvam priyālasya iti śākhinaḥ 13
atha a sau harṣitaḥ tasya phalam a prāpya cakrikaḥ
sa saṃraṃbheṇa jñātvā vai nija vaktra aṃtare dadau 14
sa dadau tat phalam yāvat nija vaktra aṃtare dvija
praviveśa galam tāvat tad phalam śṛṇu jaimine 15
tāvat savyena hastena gala randhraṃba baṃdhasaḥ
yatnāt vidhṛtya savyena pāṇinā sakalam dvija
cakrikaḥ cintayāmāsa hari bhakti parāyaṇaḥ
phalam etat yadā tasmai na dadāmi murāraye 17
na jātaḥ kaḥ pi saṃsāre tadā aham iva pātakī
harim saṃciṃtya bahudhā sa cakāra matim tatas
tathā api tat phalam tasyana niṣkrāṃtam galāt divaja
hareḥ ekānta bhaktaḥ ūsau chittvā paraśuṇā galam
ānīya tat phalam pakvam dadau devāya viṣṇave
tad sannidhim samāyātaḥ tam eva hṛdi ciṃtayan
rudhira ukṣita sarva aṅgaḥ patitaḥ kṣiti maṇḍale
tam dṛṣṭvā bhagavān viṣṇuḥ gatāsum vyathitaḥ bhavat 21
etasya sadṛśaḥ bhaktaḥ mama kopina vidyate
yatas nija galam chittvā mama saṃtoṣaṇam kṛtam
yathā bhaktimatā anena sātvikam karma vaikṛtam
yat datvā anṛṇyam āpnoti tathā vastu kim asti me 23
dhanyaḥ yam ati dhanyaḥ yadhanyaḥ yan atra saṃśayaḥ
prāṇān api parityajya mama saṃtoṣaṇam kṛtam
brahma tvam vā aśiva tvam vā acakri tvam vā api dīyate
tadā api ānṛṇyam etasya bhaktasya na hi gamyate
iti uktvā atyaṃta saṃtuṣṭaḥ bhagavān garuḍadhvajaḥ
sva hasta kamalena āsya tataḥ mastakam aspṛśat 26
tad hasta kamala sparśāt śabaraḥ saugata vyathaḥ
samuttasthau mahā satvaḥ nārāyaṇa parāyaṇaḥ

tatas sya bhakta śreṣṭhasya nija vastreṇa keśavaḥ

cakrikā uvāca
govinda keśava hare jagadīśa viṣṇo jānāmi yadi api nate stuti yoga vākyam
stotum tathā api rasa nāmam avāṃchati tvām svāmin prasīda hara doṣam imam pravṛddham
tyaktvā bhavaṃtam akhila īśvara cakrapāṇe anyam yajaṃti manujāḥ jagatī haye vai
mūḍhāḥ te eva durita prakara eka dhāma sa anugrahaḥ tvam asi mayī api deva yasmāt
jānāti deva bhavataḥ bhavana ekanātha bhaktyā eva yadi api nṛṇām bhava baṃdha hartrīm
ekānta pāpa śabara anvaya labdha janmā viṣṇoḥ tathā api bhagavān mayi su prasannaḥ
yasya prabho tava manojña kara araviṃdam sparśam caturmukha mukhāḥ api deva vṛndāḥ
na prāpnuvaṃti viditasya mayā adya labdham tvattaḥ na kaḥ pi sadayaḥ nija sevakeṣu

yena tvayā ati balinā yamalārjunau tau deva uttamena nihatau vasudeva jena
duṣṭaḥ ca kāla yavanaḥ yudhi dhenukaḥ ca tasmai namaḥ ostu nava megha nibhāya tubhyam
śrī kṛṣṇa dāmodara bhohi anaṃtayena tvayā amarapateḥ acalā vibhūtiḥ
pūrvam kṛtā bhagavatā parameśvareṇa tasmai namaḥ astu yadu vaṃśa parāya tūbhyam
pārijātaḥ hṛtaḥ yena vijitaḥ khaḍalaḥ tvayā
līlā jita maheśāya tasmai tubhyam namaḥ namaḥ
kṛtvā vṛkodaram hetum jarāsaṃdhaḥ nipātitaḥ
bāṇa asura sya nihata a bāhavaḥ ye tvayā hatāḥ
śiśupāla uha toyena tasmai nityam namaḥ namaḥ
bhūmeḥ apahṛtaḥ bhāraḥ tvayā ayena mahātmanā
kṣattriyān māyayā a hatvā tasmai nityam namaḥ namaḥ

iti tena stutaḥ viṣṇuḥ cakrikena mahātmanā

param brahma param dhāma paramātman kṛpā maya
paśyāmi tvām aham sākṣāt varaiḥ kim aparaiḥ dvija
na dhyātā bhavataḥ mūrtiḥ pūjā cana kṛtā tava
naivedyaiḥ divya puṣpaiḥ ca divya dhūpaiḥ pradīpakaiḥ
nate smṛtāni nāmāni kadācid bhavataḥ mayā
tvad pāda salilam svāmin vidhṛtam na hi mūrddhani
na bhuktam tava naivedyam tvad bratam na mayā kṛtam
tathā api aham apaśyam tvām kim karomi aparaiḥ varaiḥ
śabara anvaya janmā asmin sarva dharma bahiṣkṛtaḥ
tathā api pāda padmaṃte daivataiḥ api durllabham
tat eva ādyam ayā prāptam varaiḥ kim aparaiḥ mama
tathā api kamalā kāṃta vara ditsuḥ yadā bhavān

vacana amṛta varṣeṇa tvadīyena mahā āśaya

yat idam vatsa medat tam tvayā kamalam uttamam
anena atyaṃta tuṣṭaḥ asmi bhaktim gṛhṇāmi harṣitaḥ 49
vyāsaḥ uvāca
iti uktvā bhagavān viṣṇuḥ bhakti grāhī dayā mayaḥ
tam āligitavān bhaktam caturbhiḥ dīrgha bāhubhiḥ
śrī bhagavān uvāca
tuṣṭaḥ asmi bhavataḥ bhaktyā vatsa cakrika sattama
yat idam vatsamedattam kṣipram bhavati niścitam
bhūya upitam mahā bhaktam āliṅgya parameśvaraḥ
tatra eva aṃtarddadhe vipra viśvātmā viśva pālakaḥ
putra dāra ādikam tyaktvā jagāma dvārakām purīm
tatra ca evam samāsādya kṛpayā kamalāpateḥ
āyuṣonteya yau mokṣam devānām api durllabham
tasmāt bhakta vaśaḥ devaḥ bhakti mātreṇa tuṣyati
na ca stotraiḥ na vittaiḥ cana tapobhiḥ japena ca
phalam yadi api ca ucchiṣṭam dattam tena dvijottama
tathā api tuṣṭavān viṣṇuḥ jñātvā bhaktim acañcalām
tasmāt nārāyaṇaḥ devaḥ saṃsāre smin mumukṣubhiḥ
ye yajaṃti dṛḍhayā kila bhaktyā vāsudeva caraṇa aṃbuja yugmam
vāsava ādi vibudha pravara ijyaṃte vrajanti manujāḥ kila mokṣam
iti śrī padmapurāṇe kriyāyogasāre ṣoḍaśaḥ adhyāyaḥ 16
saptadaśaḥ udhyāyaḥ
jaiminiḥ uvāca
punar eva guro brūhi māhātmyam kamalāpateḥ
hareḥ kathā amṛtam pītvā tṛptiḥ vā ekasya jāyate
śrī vyāsaḥ uvāca
tvad tulyaḥ kopi saṃsāre sukṛtīn ahi vidyate
yatas keśava māhātmyam śrotum icchasi bhaktitaḥ
nārāyaṇa kathā ramyā punāti evam jagattrayam
śrotāram pṛcchakam ca eva vaktāram ca dvijottama
śṛṇu lakṣmīpateḥ vatsa māhātmyam pāpa nāśanam
kathayāmi samāsena caturvarga phala pradam
bhaktyā aparamayā viṣṇum ekāham api yocayet
janma koṭi kṛtam pāpam sadyas tasya haret hariḥ
puṇya ātmā āsa katham martyaḥ yena na ārādhitaḥ hariḥ
sa katham pātakī yasya bhaktiḥ nārāyaṇe prabhau
asti sarva pura śreṣṭham puruṣottama saṃjñakam
puram sarva guṇaiḥ yuktam sarva deva gaṇa āśrayam
sarveṣām eva tīrthānām variṣṭham tat nigadyate
yatas tasmin pure ramye sākṣāt vasati keśavaḥ
tatrabhadra tanuḥ nāma pūrvam ekaḥ bhavat divajaḥ
saṃprāpta yauvanaḥ vipraḥ suṃdaraḥ kāma mohitaḥ
para loka bhayam tyaktvā vāra strī nirataḥ bhavat 10
na veda adhyayanam cakre purāṇāni ca sarvaśas
tatyāja uttama saṃjñām capākhaṃḍa jana saṅgamāt 11
a yājya dāna grāhī ca para dra vya apahārakaḥ

etat viśāla jaghane pitṛ śrāddha dinam mama

prapannaḥ asi sadā hate ājñāpaya karomi kim
sumadhyamā uvāca

sa dayaḥ ciṃtayāmāsa prajā kleśa haraḥ prabhuḥ
sṛṣṭaḥ yad durjanaḥ krūraḥ sva āśraya kleśa dāyakaḥ
prajānām damana arthāya sṛjāmi etasya kāraṇam 14
atha asau bhagavān viṣṇuḥ babhūva svayam aṃtakaḥ
sa sarjaraurava ādīn ca nirayān pāpi duḥkha dān
pāpam yaḥ sevate mūḍhaḥ na yāti paramam padam
yama ājñayā vrajet tatra narakam raurava ādikam
ekadā bhagavān viṣṇuḥ prajānām duḥkha nāśanaḥ
vainateyam samāruhya jagāma yama maṃdiram 17
tam dṛṣṭvā jagatām īśam nārāyaṇam anāmayam
dhūpa ādyaiḥ pūjayāmāsa bhāskariḥ tuṣṭa mānasaḥ
yamena abhyarcitaḥ viṣṇuḥ sarva loka eka nāyakaḥ
uvāsa dvija śārdūla pīṭhe kanaka nirmite 19
tatra upaviṣṭaḥ bhagavān yamena saha daitya hā
śuśrāva kraṃdanam dhyānam dakṣiṇasyām diśi prabho
atha asau kamalā kāṃtaḥ vismaya āviṣṭa mānasaḥ
uvāca iti yamam teṣām kutas ya kraṃdana dhvaniḥ
yamaḥ uvāca
sva hasta arjita doṣeṇa sīdaṃti camama ālaye 22
pāpa vṛkṣa phalam viṣṇo bhoktum atyanta duḥkha dam
rudaṃti pāpinaḥ tasmāt teṣām dhvaniḥ asau mahān 23
iti uktaḥ sūryaputreṇa kṛṣṇaḥ kamala locanaḥ
jagāma sahasā tatra pāpavaṃtaḥ uru daṃti te 24
tān dṛṣṭvā pāpinaḥ martyān raurava ādiṣu saṃsthitān
bhagavān ciṃtayāmāsa hṛdijāta dayaḥ prabhuḥ
mayā a sṛṣṭāḥ prajāḥ sarvāḥ a doṣeṇa nija karmaṇām
mayi sthite pi narake sīdaṃti ekānta duḥkha de
etat ca anyat ca vipra indra viciṃtya karuṇā mayaḥ
babhūva sahasā tatra svayam ekādaśī tithiḥ 27
tatas tān pāpinaḥ sarvān kārayāmāsa tat śrutam
te ca sarve paraṃdhām ayayuḥ galita kalmaṣāḥ
tasmāt ekādaśīm viṣṇo mūrtim viddhi parātmanaḥ
samasta duṣkṛti śreṣṭham vratānām vratam uttamam
ekādaśīm tithim kṛtvā pāvayaṃtīm jagattrayam
śaṃkitaḥ pāpa puruṣaḥ viṣṇun stotum upāyayau 30
tatas baddhāñjaliḥ bhakti āsa pāpa puruṣaḥ dvija
tuṣṭāva kamalā kāṃtam bhagavaṃtam janārdanam
tasya stavam samākarṇya prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ
uvāca aham prasannaḥ asmi kim te abhimatam ucyatām
pāpa puruṣā uvāca
sṛṣṭaḥ bhagavatā viṣṇo nija anugraha duḥkha daḥ
ekadaśyāḥ prabhāveṇa kṣayam prāpnomi sāṃpratam
mṛte mayi jagati asmin sarve te ca śarīriṇaḥ
bhaviṣyanti vinirmuktāḥ bhava baṃdhaiḥ śarīriṇaḥ
sarveṣu ca vimukteṣu dehi śreṣṭheṣu pūruṣam
saṃsāra kautuka āgāre kaiḥ tvam krīḍiṣyase prabho
krīḍitum yaditā iva āṃchā jagat kautuka maṃdire
ekādaśī tithi bhayāt tadā māṃtra ahi keśava
anyaiḥ puṇya sahasraiḥ tu mām haṃtum na hi śakyate
śaknoti ekādaśī puṇyām ām haṃtum vara daḥ bhava 37
manuṣya paśu kīṭeṣu tathā anyeṣu ca jaṃtuṣu

nadīṣu ca samudre ṣu vaneṣu prāṃtareṣu ca
svarge martye ca pātāle deva gaṃdharva pakṣiṣu
ekādaśī tithi bhayāt bhūyān viṣṇo upalāyitaḥ
kutra api nirbhaya sthānam na ca tena ca kutracid
koṭi brahmāṇḍa madhyeṣu devadeva sanātana
ekādaśyām tithau sthātum mayā āsthānam na labhyate
ekādaśyām aham kutra vatsyāmi nirbhayaḥ prabho
tat me kathaya deveśa tvayā a sṛṣṭaḥ asmi ahetukaḥ
vyāsaḥ uvāca
iti uktvā pāpa puruṣaḥ kleśa nāśanam acyutam
bhūmau nipatya cakraṃda sravat vāṣpa vilocanaḥ
tatas prahasya bhagavān madhu kaiṭabha mardanaḥ
ekādaśī bhayāt trastam uvāca pāpa pūruṣam
śrī bhagavān uvāca
uttiṣṭha pāpa puruṣa tyaja śokam mudam kuru
ekādaśyām tithau yatra tava sthānam vadāmi te
ekādaśyām samāyāṃtyām prapunantyām jagattrayam
sthātavyam annam āśritya abhavata a pāpa pūruṣaḥ
annam āśritya tiṣṭhaṃtam bhavaṃtam pāpa pūruṣam
na haniṣyati imat mūrtiḥ iyam ekādaśī tithiḥ
tat deva upi viprarṣe tatra eva aṃtarhitaḥ bhavat
kṛtārthaḥ pāpa puruṣaḥ yayau ca sa yathāgataḥ
tasmāt annam na bhoktavyam kadācid api sattamaiḥ
ātmanaḥ hitam icchadbhiḥ saṃprāpte harivāsare 49
saṃsāreyāni pāpāni tāni eva ekādaśī dine
annam āśritya tiṣṭhan ti śrīmat nārāyaṇa ājñayā
kurvatām sarva pāpāni narakāt niṣkṛtiḥ bhavet
ye ca annam bhuñjate trāpi te jñeyāḥ pāpinām varāḥ
bhūyas bhūyas dṛḍham vacmi śrūyatām śrūyatām janāḥ
na bhoktavyam na bhoktavyam na bhoktavyam kadācana
brahma kṣatriya viś śūdraiḥ anyaiḥ ca dvijasattama
sarvaiḥ ekādaśī kāryā caturvarga phala pradā
aṣṭādaśa nimeṣa astu kāṣṭhā proktā manīṣibhiḥ
triṃśat kāṣṭhābhiḥ ukta acakala sarva artha darśibhiḥ
kṣaṇam triṃśat kalābhiḥ syāt muhūrtaḥ dvādaśa kṣaṇaiḥ
triṃśat muhūrtā lokānām ahorātraḥ prakīrtitaḥ
taiḥ paṃñcadaśabhiḥ pakṣaḥ vijñeyaḥ dvijasattama
pakṣābhyām śukla kṛṣṇābhyām māsaḥ tu parikalpitaḥ
tasmin māse dvijaśreṣṭha pakṣayoḥ śukla kṛṣṇayoḥ
mahāpātaka yuktaḥ api karoti ekādaśīm yadi
sarva pāpa vinirmuktaḥ viṣṇu lokam avāpnuyāt
iha eva pālayet mātā sarvatra ekādaśī tithiḥ
ekādaśīvratam tyaktvā vratam anyat karoti yaḥ 59
sva kara stham maṇim tyaktvā loṣṭham gṛhṇāti mūḍha dhīḥ
ekādaśīvratam yaiḥ tu kṛtam bhakti samanvitaiḥ
taiḥ tu yajñākṛtāḥ sarve vratāni sakalāni ca
ekādaśyām ca bhuñjanti ye mohāt pāpinaḥ narāḥ
śuklāyām vā api kṛṣṇāyām teṣām ruṣṭaḥ sadā hariḥ
tena dharmāḥ kṛtāḥ sarve laṅghitāḥ yena sā atithiḥ
yathā samasta devānām śreṣṭhaḥ viṣṇuḥ prakīrtitaḥ
tathā sarva vratānām ca śreṣṭham ekādaśīvratam
ādityānām yathā sūryaḥ nakṣatrāṇām yathā śaśī
tathā sarva vrata śreṣṭham proktam ekādaśīvratam
vṛkṣāṇām ca yathā aśvatthaḥ vedānām sāma kīrtitam
tathā sarva vrata śreṣṭham proktam ekādaśīvratam
kavīnām uśanāḥ śreṣṭhaḥ varṇānām brāhmaṇaḥ yathā
tathā sarva vrata śreṣṭham proktam ekādaśīvratam

tathā vratānām sarveṣām śreṣṭham ekādaśīvratam
yathā samasta dānānām anna dānam varam smṛtam
tathā sarva vrata śreṣṭham proktam ekādaśīvratam
yathā puṇya samam mitram na asti śāstra samaḥ guruḥ
tathā eva ekādaśī tulyam vratam na asti jagattraye 69

tatas viṣṇum samabhyarcya pādya ādyaiḥ jagat īśvaram

bṛhat māṣam tathā śākam daśamyām parivarjayet 78
dvis bhojanam para annam ca madhūni maithunam tathā
bhojanam kāṃsya pātreṣu daśamyām parivarjayet 79
nimba patram ca vṛṃtākam dagdham jaṃbīram eva ca
ghṛta hīnam tathā gavyam daśamyām parivarjayet
atyanta bhojanam ca eva atyanta aśana bhojanam
tāṃbūla bhakṣaṇam ca eva daśamyām parivarjayet
daśamyām yāni vastūni niṣiddhāni dvijottama
dvādaśyām api tāni eva niṣiddhāni na saṃśayaḥ 82
daśamyām vipra śārdūla dvādaśyām api vaiṣṇavaḥ
samyak vrata phala prepsuḥ na kuryāt niśi bhojanam
atas haviṣyam kṛtvā tu daśamyāṃsa tvaraḥ vratī
aparāhṇe punar kuryāt vidhinā adaṃta dhāvanam
sāyam devālayam gatvā gṛhītvā kusuma añjalim
keśavam manasā dhmāyan maṃtram etam udīrayet
etat gṛhītam goviṃdamayā tvad puratas vratam

ati caṃcala citta ūha lobha moha maya unaraḥ
śaknomi etat bratam kartum kim tava anugrahāt ṛte
imau maṃtrau paṭhitvā tu tam eva kusumāṃjalim

tasmin eva gṛhe viṣṇoḥ viṣṇu smaraṇa tatparaḥ
kuśena śayyām āstīrya bhūmau śayanam ācaret
tatas prabhāte vimalena kuryāt daṃtadhāvanam
kallolaiḥ mukha śuddhim tu kuryāt dvādaśabhiḥ budhaḥ
nitya kriyām prakurvīta viṣṇu pūjā ādika kriyām
tatas niśāyām vipra indra sakalaiḥ vratibhiḥ janaiḥ
ekatra jāgaram kuryāt puratas jagatāṃpateḥ
sa mātṛkaḥ sa bhāryaḥ ca sa bhrātā sa pitā tathā
tathā sa putra mitraḥ cakurute jāgaram hareḥ
sa tiṣṭhet viṣṇu bhavane ciram vrata karaḥ dvija
śaṅkha cakra ādikam citram yaḥ likhet viṣṇu maṃdire
bahu janma kṛtam pāpam haret tasya janārdanaḥ
taṃḍūla cūrṇa paṃkena viṣṇoḥ āyataneṣu ca
anyaiḥ vanyaiḥ ca vā acitram likhet tasya phalam śṛṇu
putra pautra prapautraiḥ ca bhuṅkte ca sakalam śubham
śeṣe viṣṇu puraṃga tvā tatra mokṣam avāpnuyāt
uddhṛtya koṭi puruṣān nārāyaṇa puram vrajet
patākā vallibhiḥ yuktam viṣṇoḥ āyatanam janaḥ
maṇḍayati avanīpālaḥ sa labhet pratijanmani
patākā pracalaṃtī ca yāvat bhavati vāyunā
tad kartuḥ pātakam sarvam tāvat eva vinaśyati
patākā valayāḥ prājñaiḥ nānā varṇāḥ hareḥ gṛhe
sthāpitavyāḥ param sthānam icchadbhiḥ harivāsare 100
viṣṇoḥ śirasi yat chatram dhatte cārutaram janaḥ
pratijanmani vipra ṛṣi kṣattrī bhavati sa kṣitau
prati puṣpam labhet puṇyam vājimedha śata uttaram
vāsudeva dine puṣpaiḥ suṃgadhaiḥ maṃḍayan budhaḥ

yaḥ vastra gṛha nirmāṇam kurute harivāsare

śāligrāma śilām tatra pratimām vā śriyaḥ pateḥ
pañcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya sthāpayet bhaktitaḥ vratī

pāda dvaya rajaḥ hāri pavitram ati śītalam

mukha durgandha haraṇam karpūra khadira anvitam

nānā upahārān haraye yaḥ yacchet harivāsare
